basis.en: Functional hinge axis of the humero-ulnar joint: the fixed axis about which the trochlear notch of the ulna and the fovea of the radial head stay at constant gap to the trochlea and capitulum over −15…125° of flexion (RMS change of gap 1.82 mm). Started from the epicondylar line (widest direction of the distal humerus) through the centre of the trochlea (sphere fit, RMS 1.97 mm), from which the result lies 2.6°. The ISB axis (Wu et al. 2005) joins the centres of trochlea and capitulum; the capitulum sphere of this coarse humerus (RMS 0.17 mm on a 14.34 mm radius) is too poor to define it, and its centre lies 4.22 mm off the axis used.
basis.zh: 肱尺关节的功能性铰链轴：在屈曲 −15…125° 范围内，使尺骨滑车切迹、桡骨头凹与肱骨滑车、肱骨小头保持间隙不变的固定轴（间隙变化均方根 1.82 mm）。优化自通过滑车中心（球面拟合，残差 1.97 mm）的内外上髁连线方向（肱骨远端最宽的方向）出发，结果与之相差 2.6°。ISB 的轴（Wu 等 2005）连接滑车与肱骨小头的中心；但本模型肱骨网格较粗，小头的球面拟合太差（半径 14.34 mm 而残差 0.17 mm），不足以定轴，其球心距所用轴 4.22 mm。

source.name: Zarins et al. 1983, Am J Sports Med 11:152–156 (abstract): passive rotation of the knee

basis.en: Flexion axis through the centres of spheres fitted to the posterior-distal surfaces of the medial and lateral femoral condyles (radii 21.56 / 20.21 mm, RMS 0.72 / 1.38 mm): the geometric centre axis, close to the transepicondylar axis used by Grood & Suntay 1983. Centre: midpoint between the two sphere centres. Then refined to the fixed axis that best keeps the tibial plateau at constant gap to the condyles over 0–130° (turned 6.5°, moved 6.97 mm; RMS change of gap 2.86 → 2.19 mm). The axis is fixed; the real knee also rolls and glides.
basis.zh: 屈伸轴取内、外侧股骨髁后下关节面球面拟合的两球心连线（半径 21.56 / 20.21 mm，残差 0.72 / 1.38 mm），即“几何中心轴”，接近 Grood & Suntay 1983 所用的经上髁轴。中心取两球心中点。再精修为在 0–130° 内使胫骨平台与股骨髁间隙最恒定的固定轴（转动 6.5°、移动 6.97 mm；间隙变化均方根 2.86 → 2.19 mm）。轴固定不动，而真实膝关节还有滚动与滑动。

source.name: Review of patellofemoral kinematics, J Healthc Eng 2019 (PMC6451817): patellar flexion is 60–70 % of knee flexion

basis.en: The patella turns about an axis parallel to the knee's flexion axis and 10.83 mm from it, by 1.07 × the knee flexion angle. Axis position and ratio are the least-squares compromise between keeping the patellar surface at constant gap to the femur (RMS change 1.9 mm) and keeping the patellar ligament (apex of patella to tibial tuberosity, 43.98 mm) at constant length (RMS change 2.42 mm) over 15–135° of flexion. A simple coupling: no medial-lateral tracking, tilt or contact.
basis.zh: 髌骨绕一条平行于膝关节屈伸轴、距其 10.83 mm 的轴转动，角度为膝屈曲角的 1.07 倍。轴的位置与该比例是两项要求之间的最小二乘折中：在屈膝 15–135° 范围内，髌骨关节面与股骨的间隙不变（变化均方根 1.9 mm），且髌韧带（髌尖至胫骨粗隆，43.98 mm）长度不变（变化均方根 2.42 mm）。这只是简单耦合：不含内外侧轨迹、倾斜与接触。

name.zh: 髌骨屈 / 伸（随膝关节）

source.name: Review of patellofemoral kinematics, J Healthc Eng 2019 (PMC6451817): patellar flexion is 60–70 % of knee flexion

basis.en: The patella turns about an axis parallel to the knee's flexion axis and 10.95 mm from it, by 0.87 × the knee flexion angle. Axis position and ratio are the least-squares compromise between keeping the patellar surface at constant gap to the femur (RMS change 2.12 mm) and keeping the patellar ligament (apex of patella to tibial tuberosity, 50.12 mm) at constant length (RMS change 1.93 mm) over 15–135° of flexion. A simple coupling: no medial-lateral tracking, tilt or contact.
basis.zh: 髌骨绕一条平行于膝关节屈伸轴、距其 10.95 mm 的轴转动，角度为膝屈曲角的 0.87 倍。轴的位置与该比例是两项要求之间的最小二乘折中：在屈膝 15–135° 范围内，髌骨关节面与股骨的间隙不变（变化均方根 2.12 mm），且髌韧带（髌尖至胫骨粗隆，50.12 mm）长度不变（变化均方根 1.93 mm）。这只是简单耦合：不含内外侧轨迹、倾斜与接触。

source.name: Soucie et al. 2011, Haemophilia 17:500–507 — CDC Normal Joint Range of Motion Study, reference values, males 20–44 y

basis.en: Functional hinge axis of the talocrural joint: the fixed axis about which the mortise of tibia and fibula stays at constant gap to the talar dome over 40° of plantar flexion to 20° of dorsiflexion (RMS change of gap 0.72 mm; 2.56 mm for the line through the malleolar tips, the ISB axis of Wu et al. 2002, from which it lies 28.6°). Started from the axis of revolution of the talar dome.
basis.zh: 距小腿关节的功能性铰链轴：在跖屈 40° 至背屈 20° 的范围内，使胫腓骨踝穴与距骨滑车保持间隙不变的固定轴（间隙变化均方根 0.72 mm；ISB 推荐的内外踝尖连线（Wu 等 2002）为 2.56 mm，两轴相差 28.6°）。优化自距骨滑车的回转轴出发。

name.en: Left subtalar joint (with the rest of the foot)
name.zh: 左距下关节（带动足的其余部分）

source.name: Washington State DSHS form 13-585A, Range of Joint Motion Evaluation Chart
source.license: State government public form, free to access

basis.en: Started from the mean subtalar axis of Inman 1976 (42° above the sole, 23° medial to the long axis of the foot) through the centre of the talocalcaneal facets, then turned to keep the talar facets at constant gap to the calcaneus over the range of motion: 42.8° above the sole and 24.3° medial on this body (RMS change of gap 0.72 mm, from 0.78 mm). The tarsal bones here have about 200 vertices each; the literature orientation dominates the result.
basis.zh: 自 Inman 1976 的平均距下关节轴（与足底成 42°、偏足长轴内侧 23°）出发，令其通过距跟关节面的中心，再调整到使距骨关节面在活动范围内与跟骨保持间隙不变：在本模型上为与足底成 42.8°、偏内侧 24.3°（间隙变化均方根由 0.78 mm 降至 0.72 mm）。这些跗骨每块只有约 200 个顶点，结果主要由文献方向决定。

name.en: Left metatarsophalangeal joint of the big toe

source.name: Botman, Hendriks et al. 2020, PRS Global Open 8:e2907, Supplemental Digital Content 1: normal range of motion according to the AAOS

basis.en: Centre: sphere fitted to the head of the proximal bone (radius 12.95 mm, RMS 0.25 mm). Flexion axis: the direction lying in the plane of the five metatarsals and perpendicular to the toe (the phalanges of the toes are too small and too coarse here for a fit of their own). Each of these bones has only about 200 vertices, so the axis is good to several degrees at best.
basis.zh: 中心：对近侧骨的头作球面拟合（半径 12.95 mm，残差 0.25 mm）。屈伸轴：取位于五块跖骨所在平面内、并垂直于该趾长轴的方向（本模型的趾骨太小、网格太粗，无法单独拟合）。这些骨每块只有约 200 个顶点，轴的精度至多为数度。

cautions.zh: 这是运动学蒙皮，不是物理仿真：组织之间没有接触和碰撞，没有重力，软组织不会被挤开或下垂；深屈时皮肤和肌肉会互相穿插。
cautions.en: This is kinematic skinning, not physics: tissues do not touch or collide, there is no gravity, and soft tissue is neither pushed aside nor sags; in deep flexion skin and muscles pass through each other.

cautions.zh: 皮肤采用 MHR 自带的蒙皮权重（手指除外），关节换成了本骨架的关节：胸部皮肤只随椎骨、不随肋骨，深吸气时肋骨和腹直肌会顶出皮肤；足趾皮肤只随跖趾关节；肩前屈超过约 120° 和深蹲时，腋部与腹股沟的皮肤仍被明显拉长，背阔肌、三角肌等深部结构会局部穿出皮肤（最深约 3–5 cm）。
cautions.en: The skin uses MHR’s own skinning weights (except on the fingers) with this rig’s joints: chest skin follows the vertebrae, not the ribs, so in deep inspiration ribs and rectus abdominis come through it; toe skin follows the metatarsophalangeal joints only; beyond about 120° of shoulder flexion and in a deep squat the skin of the axilla and groin is still stretched markedly, and deep parts such as latissimus dorsi and deltoid come through the skin locally (by up to about 3–5 cm).

cautions.zh: 肌肉只随两端的骨改变长度，并按“体积不变”调整粗细；没有肌肉主动收缩时的隆起，也不区分肌腹与肌腱（实际上肌腱几乎不变长）。
cautions.en: Muscles only change length with the bones at their ends and are thickened or thinned to keep their volume; there is no bulge from active contraction and no distinction between belly and tendon (real tendons hardly change length).

cautions.zh: 肌肉作用线多数是起点到止点的直线：绕过骨或关节的肌肉（三角肌、臀大肌、髂腰肌等）在大角度时长度和体积修正都不准。膝周的肌肉（腘绳肌、股薄肌、缝匠肌、腓肠肌、经髌骨的股四头肌）有经过点，长度、力臂和肌肉活动按这条折线算，网格不随它变形（仍按蒙皮，所以深屈时腘绳肌等仍会贴近或穿进股骨髁）；经过点是按本模型的骨面放的近似（股骨髁后面的几个点，不是真正的缠绕曲面），膝关节又是定轴转动、没有股骨后滚，所以股二头肌等的力臂在屈膝中段偏大。
cautions.en: Most lines of action are the straight line from origin to insertion: for muscles that wrap around bone or a joint (deltoid, gluteus maximus, iliopsoas …) both the length and the volume correction are wrong at large angles. The muscles round the knee (hamstrings, gracilis, sartorius, gastrocnemius, the quadriceps through the patella) have via points, and their lengths, moment arms and activity follow that polyline, but their meshes do not (they keep their skinning, so in deep flexion the hamstrings and others still hug or pass into the femoral condyles); the via points are an approximation placed on this model’s bone surfaces (a few points behind the femoral condyles, not a true wrapping surface), and the knee turns about a fixed axis without femoral rollback, so the moment arms of biceps femoris and others read high in mid-flexion.

cautions.zh: 所有关节轴都是固定的。真实的膝关节有滚动和滑动，颞下颌关节张口时下颌头前移，拇指腕掌关节两轴不相交，脊柱各节段的瞬时轴会移动——这些都没有建模。
cautions.en: All joint axes are fixed. The real knee rolls and glides, the mandibular heads slide forward when the mouth opens, the two axes of the thumb’s carpometacarpal joint do not intersect, and the instantaneous axes of spinal segments move — none of this is modelled.

cautions.zh: 肩胛骨没有被约束在胸廓上滑动；肩肱节律只是把抬臂角度按约 2 : 1 分给盂肱关节和肩带的近似。单独转动盂肱关节超过约 90–120° 时，肱骨会穿入肩峰。
cautions.en: The scapula is not constrained to glide on the rib cage; the scapulohumeral rhythm is only an approximate 2 : 1 split of arm elevation between the glenohumeral joint and the shoulder girdle. Turning the glenohumeral joint alone beyond about 90–120° drives the humerus into the acromion.

cautions.zh: 脊柱各节段的屈伸、侧屈、旋转相互独立，没有耦合运动；胸骨和肋软骨是跟着肋骨“蒙皮”的，脊柱大幅弯曲时会被轻微拉弯。
cautions.en: Flexion, lateral bending and rotation of each spinal segment are independent, without coupled motion; the sternum and costal cartilages are skinned to the ribs and get slightly bent when the spine bends far.

cautions.zh: 每根肋只有一个绕肋颈轴的自由度。肋上提时，肺、膈、心脏和腹腔脏器只是按距离跟着附近的肋和椎骨移动；膈肌不会下降，肺不会按体积充气。
cautions.en: Every rib has one degree of freedom about the axis of its neck. When the ribs rise, lungs, diaphragm, heart and abdominal organs merely follow the nearby ribs and vertebrae by distance; the diaphragm does not descend and the lungs do not inflate by volume.

cautions.zh: 髌骨按固定比例跟随膝关节屈曲；膝关节的轴向旋转范围是屈膝位的数值，伸直时也没有被限制。活动范围是成人的平均正常值，各自由度独立限制，不代表任何个人，也没有考虑相邻关节的相互影响。
cautions.en: The patella follows knee flexion by a fixed ratio; the axial rotation range of the knee is the value for the flexed knee and is not reduced in extension. Ranges of motion are average normal adult values applied to each degree of freedom independently; they describe no individual and ignore the influence of neighbouring joints.

cautions.zh: 血管、神经和脏器按距离跟随附近的骨，保持连续但不保持长度：跨过大关节的神经血管在深屈时可能被拉长、折叠或贴进骨面。
cautions.en: Vessels, nerves and organs follow nearby bones by distance; they stay continuous but do not keep their length: where they cross a large joint they may be stretched, folded or pressed into bone in deep flexion.

cautions.zh: 腘动、静脉在膝关节后方紧贴着屈伸轴走（在髁间窝后方，距轴约 10–12 mm）。真实屈膝时它们会被挤向后方；这里不会，于是屈膝 90° 以上时有三成到七成的表面落入胫骨和股骨内；屈髋时坐骨神经也有约 5% 的表面压进骨里。输入数据里肌肉、血管、神经与骨本来就有重叠（静止时肌肉表面约 16% 在骨内），摆姿势基本不会使它加重，但也不会消除。
cautions.en: The popliteal artery and vein pass close behind the flexion axis of the knee (behind the intercondylar fossa, about 10–12 mm from the axis). In a real knee they are pushed backwards as it bends; here they are not, so from 90° of flexion a third to two thirds of their surface ends up inside tibia and femur; in hip flexion about 5 % of the sciatic nerve is pressed into bone as well. Muscles, vessels and nerves overlap bone in the input data to begin with (about 16 % of the muscle surface at rest); posing hardly adds to that, but does not remove it either.

cautions.zh: 关节中心和轴由本模型较粗的骨网格拟合得到（多数骨只有约 200–500 个顶点）：手指和足趾关节轴的精度至多为数度，各关节的拟合残差见 rig-report.json。
cautions.en: Joint centres and axes are fitted to this model’s coarse bone meshes (most bones have only about 200–500 vertices): finger and toe axes are good to several degrees at best; the residual of every fit is in rig-report.json.
